+title: 'Integration suites: slots, full circle, nested, commands, cancel, live edit'
+---
+## What
+Plan.md §15 (integration suite), second part. Use the gate and `LiveProfile` of the integration package.
+
+- `IntegrationTests/Tests/AgentsIntegrationTests/LiveSlotTests.swift`: the flash model reference runs on the flash slot; runs on two slots overlap.
+- `IntegrationTests/Tests/AgentsIntegrationTests/FullCircleTests.swift`: the root calls `start agent`, the sub-agent uses a tool, the final message is in the root transcript, the next turn reads it, and `check agent` gives the same text.
+- `IntegrationTests/Tests/AgentsIntegrationTests/LiveNestedTests.swift`: `agentSpawn` links three sessions; `parentToolCallId` joins to the `start agent` call.
+- `IntegrationTests/Tests/AgentsIntegrationTests/LiveCommandTests.swift`: a slash command gives its result; `cancel agent` stops a run; a live edit is used by the next delegation while an old run completes.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] With the gate variable set on a model host, all four files pass.
+- [ ] With the gate variable absent, they report skipped.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] The four test files above.
+- [ ] Run `cd IntegrationTests && <GATE>=1 swift test` on a model host. Expected: pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
